name: Stir the Pot
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your forearms on a stability ball and your feet hip-width apart.
Brace your core and move the ball in a small circle with your forearms, as if stirring a pot.
Do several circles in one direction, then reverse direction.
Keep your hips level and your body in a straight line. Make the circles smaller if you lose control.
image_prompt_scene: In a forearm plank with the forearms resting on a stability ball.
